info.name: File viewers
info.summary: In-browser viewers for notebooks, e-books, comics and scores
info.description: Registers Nextcloud Viewer handlers to display Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb), e-books (.epub), comic archives (.cbr/.cbz) and MuseScore files (.mscz) directly in the browser — including on public shares. Rendering is fully client-side and self-contained (no external services). MuseScore files show the score's embedded first-page preview. Pairs with the Importer app so shared notebooks can be viewed and imported, then run as a pod.
info.author: Frederik Orellana, DTU
